concepts.gloss_en: the insights/understandings of the Torah (its deep comprehension)

reason_for_human: All seven occurrences share the identical construct head תְּבוּנוֹת הַתּוֹרָה ('insights of the Torah'); the longer form only adds the adverbial לְעָמְקָהּ ('to its depth'), which qualifies but does not change the concept. Occ 3073 even uses the bare form and 3074 the long form for the same idea in the same lesson, and 3074's own paragraph alternates between רָחוֹק מִתְּבוּנוֹת הַתּוֹרָה and לִתְבוּנוֹת הַתּוֹרָה לְעָמְקָהּ, confirming they are one unit.
